text:
𝗗𝗨𝗕𝗘𝗬 𝟵/𝟱𝟯! 🔥

Harsh Dubey took 9-53 as Madhya Pradesh were bowled out for 209 in Nagpur.

First Vidarbha bowler ever with a Ranji nine-for 👏

#Cricket #RanjiTrophy

facebook.caption:
𝗛𝗔𝗥𝗦𝗛 𝗗𝗨𝗕𝗘𝗬 𝗞𝗔 𝟵/𝟱𝟯! 🔥

👉 Vidarbha vs Madhya Pradesh, Nagpur (Ranji Trophy)
👉 MP 209 pe all out, Dubey ke 9 wicket sirf 53 run mein
👉 Vidarbha ke pehle gendbaaz jinhone Ranji innings mein 9 wicket liye
👉 Purana Vidarbha record 8/39 tha (Arun Ogiral, 1967/68)

Kya Dubey ko phir se India call milni chahiye? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #RanjiTrophy #HarshDubey
